metadata.oracle_scope: Abstract finite factor math only; not a waveform oracle; no FT4 quality claims.
metadata.source: Deterministic formula_inputs() in standalone producer.py; frozen before candidate execution.
metadata.formula_convention: k is zero-based factor index; l,t,u,r each run 0..3; Python nonnegative modulo.

formulas.shift: Add exactly 1000000 to every entry of every factor in shift_of.

metadata.prior: Each source variable uniform over its allowed tones, independently; constant source-prior weight cancels in normalized marginals.
metadata.allowed: 2*G+1 rows for z[0] through z[2*G]; final boundary row is [true,false,false,false]. Other masks are abstract known-symbol/data constraints.
metadata.expected: Natural log posterior per tone for every source variable plus final boundary; impossible tones are JSON null; finite values are exact decimal strings at 100-digit working precision.
metadata.method: Enumerate all 4^(2*G) source assignments, rejecting masks. Precompute Decimal exp(score-global_factor_max); multiply complete-path factors; sum complete-path mass by variable/tone; normalize then ln. No trellis or message passing.
